text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGED: GPU autoscaler reached configured ceiling in eu-west-1 — gpu-serving queue growth detected

alex.k: Seeing sustained throttling on gpu-serving queue, spike started ~12:32 UTC. Current queue ~1.2k waiting requests. Autoscaler reports maxNodes=60, currentNodes=60.

maria.p: Confirmed customer impact: AcmeRetail and FinFlow reporting higher latency and occasional 500s on generation endpoints. Also failing internal smoke tests.

sam: @infra-oncall can we get a temporary cap bump? Need +10 nodes for 2h to drain backlog and avoid cascading client errors.

jules: What's the risk surface for adding nodes (preemptible/spot reclaim)? Any policies preventing manual override?

infra-oncall: Checking policies and IAM. Need Eng approval to perform manual override and infra-ops to apply. Pinging @alex.k @maria.p for approval. :eyes:

alex.k: I approve a temporary manual increase of +10 nodes for eu-west-1, timeboxed to 2 hours. Please log change.

maria.p: Product concurs. Prefer auto-rollback and alert if provisioning stalls >4m.

ops-bot: Autoscaler snapshot (12:34 UTC):
```
Cluster: redwood-prod-eu-west-1
NodePool: gpu-pool-1
currentNodes: 60
desiredNodes: 60
maxNodes: 60
QueueDepth(gpu-serving): 1203
AvgLatency(ms): 120
```

sam: After infra gives IAM, I'll run the change: `gcloud container clusters update redwood-prod --node-pool=gpu-pool-1 --max-nodes=70 --region=europe-west1`

infra-oncall: IAM elevated. Escalating to infra-ops to apply manual override. ETA ~2m.

infra-ops: Applying manual maxNodes update now. Backing up autoscaler config and annotating changelog.

infra-ops: Change applied — maxNodes updated to 70. Monitoring scaling events.

ops-bot: New autoscaler status (12:37 UTC):
```
currentNodes: 60
maxNodes: 70
Scaling: provisioning +8 nodes
```

jules: Pods are scheduling onto new nodes, queue trending down: 1203 -> 420 in ~3m. Clear progress.

maria.p: Notifying affected customers. AcmeRetail acknowledged the update and sees improvement.

alex.k: Good. Rollback plan: auto-revert maxNodes to 60 after 2h unless canceled. @infra-ops please set an automated rollback and an alert if any node provisioning exceeds 4m.

infra-ops: Rollback timer set for 2h (auto-revert at 14:32 UTC). Alert rule created for provisioning >4m. Changelog entry CL-2026-042 posted.

ops-bot: Queue depth now 87, average latency back to baseline.

sam: Nice work. Please capture this in a short postmortem: trigger conditions, why autoscaler hit ceiling, and a proposal to allow brief burst increases via a safe override lane.

jules: Adding runbook note: when gpu queue >1000 and timeToClear >5m, follow manual cap bump playbook and notify customers.

incident-bot: Incident resolved and closed. Summary: Temporary manual maxNodes bump from 60 to 70 in eu-west-1 applied to mitigate queue surge causing customer errors; auto-rollback scheduled for 2h. Participants: alex.k, maria.p, sam, jules, infra-ops.
